title: The v6 Module column names a different service from the realigned owner
source: 09 Testing and quality/Recovery Workbench Requirements Traceability Matrix v6.xlsx
description: 14 of 231 requirements name in Module a service other than the realigned owner, read as the service whose PRD functional requirements carry the requirement and, where it has no FR, as the Ownership Map owner of its legacy key (REQ-ILG-001, REQ-ILG-002, REQ-ILG-003, REQ-ILG-004, REQ-ILG-005, REQ-ILG-006, REQ-ILG-007, REQ-ILG-008, REQ-ILG-009, REQ-ILG-010, REQ-ILG-011, REQ-ILG-012, ...).
evidence: 20 PRD files (FR tables and the 11.2 requirement trace summary); 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Ownership Map v1.xlsx (Services, Tables, Endpoints, Events, Workflows and activities, Jobs); _work/msr/plan/ownership.json; R3 default rulings (interaction ledger to rwb-source-data, parameters and reference data to rwb-case, rule package registry to rwb-decision)
proposed: The v7 Owner column carries the realigned owner; the v6 Module column is kept unchanged beside it so the change is visible.

title: Requirements with no PRD functional requirement
description: 6 requirements are named in a PRD as an upstream requirement ID but no functional requirement of any PRD carries them (REQ-DVH-011, REQ-ILG-004, REQ-ILG-009, REQ-ILG-011, REQ-ILG-012, REQ-ILG-013). REQ-RDF-005 and REQ-RDF-006 are withdrawn under D-RCV-35 U5, and REQ-DRI-009 is retired with the data lake, so those three carry no functional requirement by design.
evidence: Every PRD file read in full; the FR tables and the 11.2 trace summary name no FR for these IDs
proposed: The product owner confirms the requirement or withdraws it; until then the v7 matrix flags it and no FR is claimed.

title: Requirements that no realigned story cites
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Service Story Files v1/
description: 9 requirements are cited in no story section 18 and have no legacy key, so no realigned story owns them (REQ-DCM-014, REQ-S1-005, REQ-S3-006, REQ-S4-008, REQ-S4-009, REQ-S5-002, REQ-S5-007, REQ-S5-009, REQ-S8-006).
evidence: All 1,065 story files read for the REQ IDs in section 18; _work/msr/fragments holds no requirement list for them
proposed: Assign each requirement to a story in the next story pass; the v7 matrix flags it as an orphan.

title: A requirement whose own legacy stories do not cite it
source: 09 Testing and quality/Recovery Workbench Requirements Traceability Matrix v6.xlsx
description: REQ-RDF-004 names RWB-E1-069, RWB-E1-018 and RWB-E2-006 in v6, but the realigned stories of those keys do not cite it in section 18; the collateral and appraisal citations sit in the E3 integration stories instead.
evidence: Story section 18 tables of the slices of RWB-E1-069, RWB-E1-018 and RWB-E2-006; REQ-RDF-004 found in RWB-ITG-E3013-ITG, RWB-ITG-E3017-ITG and RWB-ITG-E3026-ITG
proposed: The E1 owner adds REQ-RDF-004 to its section 18 row, or the E3 integration trace is accepted; the v7 row lists the legacy slices and the citing stories.

title: No legacy key for requirements written before the realignment
source: 09 Testing and quality/Recovery Workbench Requirements Traceability Matrix v6.xlsx
description: 97 requirements carried no story in v6 ('No story yet', 'Epic 3 backlog' and similar), so the v6 matrix gives them no legacy key; under D-RCV-60 the story link is read from section 18 of the story files instead.
evidence: RTM v6 column Stories; story section 18 tables; _work/msr/plan/split_plan.json has no entry for these requirements
proposed: Keep the v6 cell unchanged and read the story link from section 18; the v7 Legacy keys cell says no legacy key exists.

title: The v6 coverage statement no longer describes the story position
source: 09 Testing and quality/Recovery Workbench Requirements Traceability Matrix v6.xlsx
description: The v6 Coverage sheet says 10 requirements have no story and 82 are written one epic ahead; after the realignment every requirement with a story is traced to a realigned story, so the statuses are outdated.
evidence: RTM v6 Coverage rows E2 'No story yet' 10, E3 to E8 'Story one epic ahead' 82
proposed: The v6 coverage block is kept unchanged as history and a realignment block is added below it.

title: No issue-tracker, branch, commit or pull-request metadata
description: No issue, branch, commit or pull request exists for this run, and the run makes no external writes, so the matrix records none rather than an empty plausible value.
evidence: R1 U6 (no issue-tracker access or updates); AGENTS.md rule 3 (no external writes, no commits)
proposed: Add the metadata in the delivery tool when the work is scheduled; no value is invented here.

title: Every realigned artifact is Draft with no approval
description: No human approval exists in this run, so every requirement, story, PRD and test artifact is Draft and the review status of each row is Draft.
evidence: R1 U8 (no human verification stops in this run); the D-RCV-60 overlay assumes approval and continues.
proposed: Run the verification loop before the first wave starts.
